translation_notes: context shim: infixowl_context.py is rdflib/extras/infixowl.py from the same commit, vendored verbatim except its dead `from rdflib import py3compat` import; imported identically by both sides for classOrIdentifier

the single graph.add((s, p, o)) becomes `self.graph += g{ {self.identifier} {self._operator} {self._rdfList.uri} }` — a faithful but gain-free island: all three terms are computed, so the notation buys nothing here (negative finding)
the declared prefixes rdf:/rdfs: of the mechanical draft were dropped: the region builds no term from a namespace, so nothing to declare

BNode() and Collection(...) stay Python: the collection is built through the rdflib Collection API over a pre-existing head node, which no ( ... ) island can express (an island collection would create its own cells)
driver: StubProxy stands in for the class instance (identifier, _operator, graph); two fixtures cover both branches (fresh collection + link triple, and append to an existing collection)
